sections.label: Core
sections.info: Configure CPU emulation, timing, and core system settings.

items.label: Core > CPU Core
items.info: Select CPU emulation method - JIT provides best performance.

items.label: Core > CPU Clock Rate
items.info: Adjust emulated CPU speed.

items.label: Core > Emulation Speed
items.info: Set speed limit for emulation.

items.label: Core > Dual Core Mode
items.info: Enable dual-core CPU emulation. Requires core RESTART.

items.label: Core > Synchronize GPU Thread
items.info: Keeps the dual-core GPU thread in step with the CPU thread, which stops FIFO desyncs at some speed cost. Requires core RESTART.

items.label: Core > Load Whole Game Into Memory
items.info: Load Whole Game Into Memory. Requires core RESTART.

items.label: Core > Precision Frame Timing
items.info: Use busy-wait for more accurate frame timing.

items.label: Core > Fastmem
items.info: Enable fastmem optimization - which uses memory mapping for faster access.

items.label: Core > Fastmem Arena
items.info: Enable fastmem arena - reserves 12 GiB of virtual memory for super fast access.

items.label: Core > Accurate CPU cache
items.info: Enabled - fast, Disabled - guarantees correctness involving cache behaviour.

items.label: Core > Internal Cheats
items.info: Enable built-in cheat codes. Restart core to take effect.

items.label: Core > Skip GameCube BIOS
items.info: Skip the GameCube BIOS animation/menu and start the game directly.

items.label: Core > Disc Based Games Boot to Wii Menu
items.labelCategorized: Disc Based Games Boot to Wii System Menu
items.info: When a Wii System Menu is installed in the save location and the game is a disc based game, it will start the Wii Menu with the disc inserted in the drive instead of directly booting the game. Beware: The game region must match the Wii Menu region otherwise the game will not be recognized.

items.label: Core > System Language
items.info: Set system language.

items.label: Core > Speed Up Disc Transfer
items.info: Reduce loading times.

items.label: Core > Enable MMU
items.info: Enable emulation of the Memory Management Unit.

items.label: Core > Rush Frame Presentation
items.info: Enable rushing frame presentation for lower latency.

items.label: Core > Smooth Early Presentation
items.info: Enable smoother early frame presentation timing.

sections.label: Audio / DSP
sections.info: Configure audio output and DSP emulation.

items.label: Audio / DSP > DSP HLE
items.info: Choose DSP method - HLE is faster, LLE is more accurate.

items.label: Audio / DSP > DSP JIT
items.info: Enable JIT for DSP LLE.

items.label: Audio / DSP > Async Audio Callback
items.info: Use asynchronous audio callbacks.
labels: Sync - Per Frame using target refresh rate
Async - driven by callbacks using refresh rate and audio buffer status

items.label: Interface > On-Screen Display
items.info: Show OSD messages.

items.label: Interface > Log Level
items.info: Set log verbosity.

items.label: Interface > Logging > Boot
items.info: Enable Boot log messages.

items.label: Interface > Logging > Core
items.info: Enable Core log messages.

items.label: Interface > Logging > Video
items.info: Enable Video log messages.

items.label: Interface > Logging > Common
items.info: Enable Common log messages.

items.label: Interface > Logging > Host GPU
items.info: Enable Host GPU log messages.

items.label: Interface > Logging > MemMap
items.info: Enable MemMap log messages.

items.label: Interface > Logging > DSP Interface
items.info: Enable DSP Interface log messages.

items.label: Interface > Logging > DSP HLE
items.info: Enable DSP HLE log messages.

items.label: Interface > Logging > DSP LLE
items.info: Enable DSP LLE log messages.

items.label: Interface > Logging > DSP MAIL
items.info: Enable DSP MAIL log messages.

items.label: Interface > Enable debugging
items.info: Enable the debugger.

items.label: System Configuration (GC) > SP1 Device
items.info: Select the device connected to the GameCube SP1 slot.

items.label: System Configuration (GC) > GameCube Microphone
items.info: Emulate the official GameCube microphone accessory. Restart core after changing this option.

items.label: System Configuration (GC) > Microphone Button
items.info: Button to hold or press to activate the microphone input. Selecting OFF disables microphone activation.

items.label: System Configuration > Widescreen (Wii)
items.info: Enable widescreen for Wii.

items.label: System Configuration > Progressive Scan
items.info: Enable progressive scan.

items.label: System Configuration > PAL60 Mode
items.info: Enable 60Hz for PAL games.

items.label: System Configuration > Sensor Bar Position
items.info: Set Wiimote sensor bar position.

items.label: System Configuration > Controller Rumble
items.info: Enable rumble feedback.

items.label: System Configuration > Wiimote Continuous Scanning
items.info: Continuously scan for Wiimotes.

items.label: System Configuration > Alt GC Ports (Wii)
items.info: Use ports 5-8 for GameCube controllers in Wii mode.

items.label: System Configuration > Bluetooth passthrough mode
items.info: Pass all traffic directly to the host's Bluetooth adapter. Press F12 to begin the sync process.

items.label: System Configuration > Wii Speak
items.info: Emulate the Wii Speak microphone. Restart when changing this option.

items.label: Audio > Devices > Wii Speak Muted
items.info: Mute or unmute the Wii Speak microphone.

items.label: System Configuration > Logitech USB Microphone
items.info: Emulate the Logitech USB microphone. Restart when changing this option.

sections.label: Graphics > Settings
sections.info: Configure rendering backend and quality settings.

items.label: Graphics > Settings > Graphics Backend
items.info: Select rendering backend.

items.label: Graphics > Settings > Widescreen Hack
items.info: Force 16:9 rendering.

items.label: Graphics > Settings > Aspect Ratio
items.info: Control how the game's image is scaled.

items.label: Graphics > Settings > Crop Overscan
items.info: Report standard TV output resolution to the frontend (NTSC: 480, PAL: 576). Recommended for CRT displays with SwitchRes.

items.label: Graphics > Settings > Internal Resolution
items.info: Multiply native resolution.

items.label: Graphics > Settings > Shader Compilation
items.info: Control shader compilation.

items.label: Graphics > Settings > Wait for Shaders
items.info: Precompile shaders before starting.

items.label: Graphics > Settings > Anti-Aliasing
items.info: Reduce jagged edges.

items.label: Graphics > Settings > Texture Cache Accuracy
items.info: Texture cache safety level.

items.label: Graphics > Settings > GPU Texture Decoding
items.info: Decode textures on GPU.

items.label: Graphics > Settings > Pixel Lighting
items.info: Enable per-pixel lighting calculations instead of per-vertex.

items.label: Graphics > Settings > Fast Depth Calculation
items.info: Use faster depth calculation.

items.label: Graphics > Settings > Disable Fog
items.info: Disable fog rendering effects. May improve performance but reduces visual accuracy.

items.label: Graphics > Settings > Enable Mods
items.info: Loads graphic mods from User/Load/GraphicsMods.

sections.label: Graphics > Enhancements
sections.info: Configure texture filtering and visual enhancements.

items.label: Graphics > Enhancements > Texture Filtering
items.info: Override texture filtering.

items.label: Graphics > Enhancements > Anisotropic Filtering
items.info: Improve texture quality at angles.

items.label: Graphics > Enhancements > Load Custom Textures
items.info: Load high-res texture packs.

items.label: Graphics > Enhancements > Prefetch Custom Textures
items.info: Preload custom textures.

items.label: Graphics > Enhancements > Output Resampling
items.info: Select the resampling filter used when scaling the final image.

items.label: Graphics > Enhancements > Force True Color
items.info: Disable dithering and force 24-bit color output instead of 18-bit.

items.label: Graphics > Enhancements > Disable Copy Filter
items.info: Disable the GameCube/Wii copy filter. Removes blur from some games but may reduce accuracy.

items.label: Graphics > Enhancements > HDR Output
items.info: Enable High Dynamic Range output when supported by the graphics backend and display.

items.label: Graphics > Enhancements > Arbitrary Mipmap Detection
items.info: Enable detection of arbitrary mipmaps. Improves accuracy in some games but may reduce performance.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > EFB Access from CPU
items.info: Allow CPU EFB access. Required for some games but slow.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > EFB Access Defer Invalidation
items.info: Defer EFB cache invalidation.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > EFB Access Tile Size
items.info: EFB access granularity.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > Bounding Box
items.info: Emulate bounding box hardware. Required for Paper Mario TTYD.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > Force Progressive
items.info: Force progressive scan.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > Skip EFB Copy to RAM
items.info: Store EFB in texture memory.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > Skip XFB Copy to RAM
items.info: Store XFB in texture memory.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > Disable EFB to VRAM
items.info: Disable EFB VRAM copies.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > Defer EFB Copies
items.info: Defer EFB copies until needed.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > Immediate XFB
items.info: Display XFB immediately.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > Skip Duplicate Frames
items.info: Don't present duplicate frames.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > Early XFB Output
items.info: Output XFB early.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > EFB Scaled Copy
items.info: Scale EFB copy by IR.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > EFB Emulate Format Changes
items.info: Emulate EFB format changes (needed for some effects).

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > Vertex Rounding
items.info: Round vertex positions to avoid gaps.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > VI Skip
items.info: Skip VI updates to improve performance.

items.label: Graphics > Hacks > Fast Texture Sampling
items.info: Use faster but less accurate texture sampling.

items.label: Graphics > Game Specific > Performance Queries
items.info: Enable performance queries.

sections.label: Wiimote IR / Gyro / Swing
sections.info: Configure Wiimote infrared pointer, gyro and swing settings.

items.label: WiiMote Sideways > Toggle Button
items.info: Button used to toggle sideways mode. Can be disabled.

items.label: WiiMote Upright > Toggle Button
items.info: Button used to toggle upright mode. Can be disabled.

items.label: Wiimote IR > Wiimote IR Mode
items.info: Control method for Wiimote pointer.

items.label: Wiimote IR > Wiimote IR Vertical Offset
items.info: Adjust vertical center of Wiimote pointer.

items.label: Wiimote IR > Wiimote IR Total Yaw
items.info: Horizontal field of view for Wiimote pointer.

items.label: Wiimote IR > Wiimote IR Total Pitch
items.info: Vertical field of view for Wiimote pointer.

items.label: Wiimote IR > Wiimote IR Deadzone
items.info: Amount of small IR‑cursor movement to ignore (0–50%).

items.label: WiiMote IR > Modifier Button
items.info: Button used as a modifier for IR control. With no modifier selected, IR is always active with right thumbstick.

items.label: WiiMote Swing > Modifier Button
items.info: Button to hold while using right thumbstick to activate swing. OFF turns off swing. Selecting none will allow free use of right thumb stick to swing (It will automatically filter out L3).

items.label: Wiimote Swing > Angle
items.info: Rotation applied at the extremities of a swing (1-180°).

items.label: Wiimote IR > Wiimote IR Passthrough
items.info: Take the Wiimote camera's view of the sensor bar straight from the frontend, instead of deriving it from a cursor position. The frontend supplies up to four IR objects on pointer indices 1-4; Wiimote IR Mode, Total Yaw, Total Pitch and Vertical Offset are all bypassed. For frontends that know the real geometry (a VR room, a tracked light gun) this is exact, and it carries roll and distance, which a cursor cannot. Leave off for a mouse or a gamepad.

sections.label: RetroArch Core
sections.info: Configure settings which are specific to the RetroArch core and do not exist in dolphin standlone.

items.label: RetroArch Core > Automatically Import Cheats into RetroArch
items.info: Import dolphin ini files into RetroArch. Restart core to take effect.

items.label: RetroArch core > Load & Prevent Save Settings
items.info: Choose whether to load core settings from GCPad.ini/WiimoteNew.ini and also prevent saving to them. Core options may no longer be reflected correctly in RetroArch interface. Editing ini files incorrectly will likely crash the emulator.

items.label: RetroArch core > Enable Virtual File System (VFS)
items.info: Enable VFS for SAF/SMB etc. Requires core RESTART. This feature is NEW and EXPERIMENTAL. Backup your saves regularly.

items.label: RetroArch core > Enable Default Mouse Bindings
items.info: Enable default Mouse Bindings, disable for more control on bindings.

sections.label: Wiimote (DSU)
sections.info: Configure DSU client for DualShock motion data.

items.label: Wiimote (DSU) > Enable DSU Client
items.info: Enable DSU client for DualShock motion data. Restart core to take effect.

items.label: Wiimote (DSU) > Server IP Octet 1
items.info: First octet of DSU server IP. e.g. for 192.168.1.10 set this to 192.

items.label: Wiimote (DSU) > Server IP Octet 2
items.info: Second octet of DSU server IP. e.g. for 192.168.1.10 set this to 168.

items.label: Wiimote (DSU) > Server IP Octet 3
items.info: Third octet of DSU server IP. e.g. for 192.168.1.10 set this to 1.

items.label: Wiimote (DSU) > Server IP Octet 4
items.info: Fourth octet of DSU server IP. e.g. for 192.168.1.10 set this to 10.

items.label: Wiimote (DSU) > Server Port
items.info: UDP port of DSU server. Default is 26760.
